statement: For a one-place ray field H/K over a real quadratic field, nontrivial sign class implies 2 divides [H:H intersect Q^ab]. Equivalently, an odd genuine Shintani index implies empty differenced Fourier support.

proof_invariants.real_place_involutions: c1 and c2 are conjugate in the genuine normal closure
proof_invariants.one_place_image: the image of c1*c2^(-1) is the sign class R
proof_invariants.parity_conclusion: if R is nontrivial, the commutator image contains an element of order two

scope_boundary: The proof requires the actual normal closure; proxy conjugation coordinates at an unstable modulus are excluded.
